title: Survival In-Context: Amortized Bayesian Survival Analysis via Prior-Fitted Networks
abstract: arXiv:2603.29475v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Survival analysis is crucial for many medical applications, but remains challenging for modern machine learning due to limited data, censoring, and the heterogeneity of tabular covariates. While the prior-fitted paradigm, which relies on pretraining models on large collections of synthetic datasets, has recently facilitated tabular foundation models for classification and regression, its suitability for time-to-event modeling remains unclear. We propose a flexible survival data generation framework that defines a rich survival prior with explicit control over covariates and time-event distributions. Building on this prior, we introduce Survival In-Context (SIC), a prior-fitted in-context learning model for survival analysis that is pretrained exclusively on synthetic data. translated_title: 上下文生存分析：基于先验拟合网络的摊销贝叶斯生存分析
translated_abstract: 生存分析对许多医学应用至关重要，但由于数据有限、删失以及表格协变量的异质性，它对现代机器学习而言仍然具有挑战性。虽然先验拟合范式——即在大量合成数据集集合上预训练模型——最近催生了用于分类和回归的表格基础模型，但其在时间-事件建模中的适用性仍不明确。我们提出了一个灵活的生存数据生成框架，该框架定义了一个丰富的生存先验，可对协变量和时间-事件分布进行显式控制。基于这一先验，我们引入了 Survival In-Context (SIC)，这是一种完全在合成数据上预训练的、用于生存分析的先验拟合上下文学习模型。SIC 被训练用于在合成生存先验下近似贝叶斯后验预测推断，从而能够在单次前向传播中实现个体化的生存预测。
tldr: 本文提出SIC模型，通过将先验拟合网络在合成生存数据上预训练以摊销贝叶斯后验预测推断，实现了仅凭单次前向传播即可完成个体化生存预测的上下文学习生存分析方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Survival In-Context (SIC), a prior-fitted in-context learning model pretrained on synthetic survival data that amortizes Bayesian posterior predictive inference, enabling individualized survival prediction in a single forward pass.
